title: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Caput Primum tip)
author: Josué de la Place (Placeus)
edition: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Salmurii: Apud Ioannem Lesnerium, 1661). IA deimputationepri00lapl. Tip: Caput Primum (Decretum Synodi Charentonii 1644/45 + Placeus framing). Earlier 1655 Saumur print exists; tip copy-text is the 1661 Lesnerius.
blurb: Josué de la Place (Placeus) — Caput Primum of De imputatione primi peccati Adami from the 1661 Saumur Latin: the Charenton National Synod decree on original sin and imputation, and Placeus's framing that his judgment was neither condemned nor what rumor made it. Tip only; the rest of the Disputatio remains.
era_note: Placeus wrote in the mid-seventeenth century as Reformed theology professor at the Academy of Saumur. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed / Saumur retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1661 Saumur Latin is public domain. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this Latin work was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for the Caput Primum tip only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1661 Saumur Latin of Caput Primum, reconstructed from IA PDF page images (leaves 11-14) with pdftotext and tesseract as check. No modern English was copied. Amyraut Brief traité (French) was not used; Placeus Latin is the Saumur-lane lock.
